questions.question_english: During the recruitment of clerical staff in a government educational institution, a vacancy reserved for a person with benchmark disability remains unfilled due to the non-availability of a suitable candidate. What is the mandatory immediate procedural step under Section 34(2) of the RPwD Act, 2016?
options_english: The vacancy must be immediately de-reserved and filled by a general (unreserved) candidate in that cycle
The vacancy must be carried forward to the succeeding recruitment year as a backlog vacancy
The vacancy must be permanently converted into an SC or ST reserved vacancy
The recruitment process must be completely cancelled and the post permanently abolished
questions.explanation_english:
Section 34(2) of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016 explicitly establishes the procedure for unfilled reserved vacancies:
'Where in any recruitment year any vacancy cannot be filled up under sub-section (1) due to non-availability of a suitable person with benchmark disability or for any other sufficient reasons, such vacancy shall be carried forward in the succeeding recruitment year...'

The statute further provides that if in the succeeding recruitment year also a suitable candidate from that specific category is unavailable, the vacancy may first be filled by interchange among the five specified disability categories. Only when there is no person with disability available even after interchange can the post be filled by appointing a person other than a person with disability. Therefore, the immediate mandatory procedural step is to carry forward the vacancy to the next recruitment year; immediate de-reservation is strictly prohibited.
questions.explanation_hindi:
दिव्यांगजन अधिकार अधिनियम (RPwD Act), 2016 की धारा 34(2) में रिक्त पदों को भरने की सुस्पष्ट प्रक्रिया विहित की गई है:
'यदि किसी भर्ती वर्ष में उपधारा (1) के अधीन कोई रिक्ति उपयुक्त बेंचमार्क दिव्यांग व्यक्ति के उपलब्ध न होने के कारण अथवा किसी अन्य पर्याप्त कारण से नहीं भरी जा सकती है, तो ऐसी रिक्ति को आगामी भर्ती वर्ष में अग्रेषित (carried forward) किया जाएगा...'

questions.explanation_english: Section 23 of the POCSO Act, 2012 governs the 'Procedure for media' and strictly bars the disclosure of the child's identity. Under Section 23(1), no person shall make any report or present comments on any child from any form of media or studio or photographic facilities without having complete and authentic information, which may lower the child's reputation or infringe upon their privacy. Section 23(2) categorically prohibits disclosing the name, address, photograph, family details, school, neighborhood, or any other particulars that may lead to revealing the identity of the child in any print, electronic, or digital media, unless the Special Court permits such disclosure in writing in the interest of the child. Section 23(4) prescribes criminal penalties for contravention: imprisonment for a term not less than six months which may extend to one year, or fine, or both. For educational institutions and Principals, Section 23 read with institutional child protection protocols mandates that no student identity or incident details be leaked or shared with the press.

questions.explanation_english:

However, to claim tax exemption for this carried-over journey, the employee MUST perform that journey in the FIRST calendar year of the immediately succeeding block. If availed in that first calendar year, it does not count against the regular quota of two journeys permitted for that new block, effectively allowing three exempt journeys in that block.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the exemption of House Rent Allowance (HRA) under the Income Tax Act:
I. An employee can claim HRA exemption even if residing in their own residential accommodation, provided they pay a notional rent.
II. If the annual rent paid by the employee exceeds ₹1,00,000, it is mandatory to report the PAN of the landlord to the employer to claim the exemption.
III. Both HRA exemption and home loan interest deduction under Section 24(b) can be claimed simultaneously if the employee owns a house but resides in a rented accommodation due to genuine employment reasons.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hindi:
आयकर अधिनियम के तहत मकान किराया भत्ता (HRA) छूट के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
I. एक कर्मचारी अपने स्वयं के स्वामित्व वाले मकान में रहते हुए भी HRA छूट का दावा कर सकता है, बशर्ते वह सांकेतिक (notional) किराया चुकाए।
II. यदि कर्मचारी द्वारा चुकाया गया वार्षिक किराया ₹1,00,000 से अधिक है, तो छूट प्राप्त करने के लिए नियोक्ता को मकान मालिक का PAN प्रस्तुत करना अनिवार्य है।
III. यदि कर्मचारी के पास अपना मकान है लेकिन वह सेवा/रोजगार के वैध कारणों से किराए के मकान में रहता है, तो वह HRA छूट और धारा 24(b) के तहत गृह ऋण ब्याज कटौती दोनों का एक साथ दावा कर सकता है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II, and III
options_hindi: केवल I और II
केवल II और III
केवल I और III
I, II और III
questions.explanation_english:
Statement I is incorrect: The explanation to Section 10(13A) explicitly states that the exemption does not apply to an assessee where the residential accommodation occupied by the assessee is owned by them, or where no expenditure on rent is actually incurred. Living in one's own house and paying notional rent is strictly prohibited.
Statement II is correct: As per CBDT Circulars and Rule 26C, if annual rent paid exceeds ₹1,00,000, the employee must report the Name, Address, and Permanent Account Number (PAN) of the landlord to the employer (DDO) in Form 12BB.
Statement III is correct: An employee who owns a residential house (for example, in another city or at a distant location) and avails home loan interest deduction under Section 24(b) (up to ₹2,00,000 for self-occupied property) can simultaneously claim HRA exemption under Section 10(13A) if they reside in rented premises at the place of posting due to genuine professional/employment constraints.
Therefore, Statements II and III only are correct.

questions.question_english: If an aggrieved woman approaches the ICC with an oral complaint of sexual harassment, what is the statutory duty of the Presiding Officer or any ICC member under Section 9(1) of the POSH Act?
options_english: Assist her in making the complaint in writing
Reject the oral complaint immediately as only written complaints are statutory
Direct her to file a criminal police complaint at the nearest station instead
Record the oral statement verbatim and treat it as a formal written complaint
questions.explanation_english:
Under the first proviso to Section 9(1) of the POSH Act, 2013, the statute establishes a clear affirmative obligation on the committee:
'Provided that where such complaint cannot be made in writing, the Presiding Officer or any Member of the Internal Committee or the Chairperson or any Member of the Local Committee, as the case may be, shall render all reasonable assistance to the woman for making the complaint in writing.'

Key Principles:
1. Non-rejection: An oral complaint cannot be rejected or turned away simply because it lacks a pre-drafted written petition.
2. Duty of Reasonable Assistance: The Presiding Officer or any member must sit with the complainant, listen patiently, assist her in articulating the factual allegations, reduce them to writing, read it back to her, and obtain her signature/acknowledgement.
3. School Principal's Duty: In educational institutions, administrators must ensure that female teachers, non-teaching staff, and students receive supportive assistance rather than bureaucratic resistance.

Therefore, option (A) is the statutorily mandated duty.
questions.explanation_hindi:
पॉश अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 9(1) के प्रथम परंतुक (First Proviso) के अनुसार:
'परंतु जहां ऐसी शिकायत लिखित रूप में नहीं की जा सकती, वहां, यथास्थिति, आंतरिक समिति का पीठासीन अधिकारी या कोई सदस्य अथवा स्थानीय समिति का अध्यक्ष या कोई सदस्य, महिला को लिखित रूप में शिकायत करने के लिए सभी युक्तियुक्त सहायता (ऑल रीजनेबल असिस्टेंस) प्रदान करेगा।'

विधिक दायित्व के प्रमुख पहलू:
1. सकारात्मक विधिक दायित्व: अधिनियम समिति के सदस्यों पर यह बाध्यकारी दायित्व डालता है कि यदि व्यथित महिला केवल मौखिक शिकायत लेकर आती है, तो समिति उसे अपनी बात लिखित रूप में लिपिबद्ध करने में पूर्ण सहायता प्रदान करेगी।
2. शिकायत अस्वीकार करने पर रोक: आंतरिक समिति या विद्यालय प्रमुख इस आधार पर शिकायत को खारिज नहीं कर सकते कि वह लिखित रूप में नहीं लाई गई है, न ही पीड़िता को लौटाया जा सकता है।
3. न्याय तक सुलभ पहुंच: इस प्रावधान का उद्देश्य यह सुनिश्चित करना है कि अशिक्षा, भाषागत कठिनाई, घबराहट या मानसिक तनाव के कारण किसी भी महिला की न्याय तक पहुंच बाधित न हो।

अतः विकल्प A सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Assist her in making the complaint in writing

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Section 9(1) establishes that when an aggrieved woman cannot make a written complaint, the Presiding Officer or any member of the committee must render all reasonable assistance to her for making the complaint in writing. Oral complaints cannot be rejected outright, and committee members must actively facilitate formal documentation.
